blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
blocks.zh: 通过提供场景描述和推理能力,将视觉语言模型(VLMs)整合到端对端(E2E)自主驱动中,展现了强大的潜力. 然而,VLM在计算上成本很高,运行时切换语言推理而不会伤害闭路性能,这阻碍了实际的采用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DRIFT,一个E2E自主驱动框架,将轻量级语言模型(LM)用于视觉问答和动作评论. 通过高效地将中间驱动表示投射到语言嵌入空间中,我们证明一个紧凑的LM(<150M参数)可以实现强烈的场景描述和行动评论. 此外,我们引入了一个运行时间灵活的规划模块,该模块对从LM中提炼出来的替代推理特征进行了培训,并且可以在推断时以LM或替代推理特征为条件。 这种设计能够在部署限制需要时完全绕过LM,而不牺牲驾驶性能. DRIFT只有255M参数,在Bench2Drive上,通过将LM和代理推理按选定的推理率进行互调,达到97.03的驱动分数和89.39%(平均超过3次)的成功率。 这与最强的非语言模型相同,但远比基于VLM的现有模型更为紧凑。 DRIFT进一步在现实世界的NAVSIM和AlpaSim基准上以大大低于现有基于VLM的方法的计算成本实现竞争结果. 项目网页:https://drift-e2e.github.io/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
End-to-end (E2E) driving models [ 13 , 16 ] achieve promising driving performance, but they lack interpretability and high-level semantic reasoning. To address these limitations, recent works have integrated vision-language models (VLMs) into the driving pipeline, enabling visual question answering (VQA) [ 32 , 34 ] and language-guided reasoning [ 32 , 8 ] .
Despite their success, existing VLM-based E2E methods typically improve language performance by scaling up the language models (LMs), incurring substantial computational overhead. Approaches such as DriveVLM [ 34 ] , ORION [ 8 ] , and AdaThinkDrive [ 25 ] employ models exceeding 7B parameters, making real-time deployment on edge hardware increasingly challenging. This motivates us to study how strong language reasoning can be achieved with a significantly smaller LM.
blocks.zh:
端对端(E2E)驱动模型[13,16]实现有前途的驱动性能,但它们缺乏可解释性和高级语义推理. 为了消除这些局限性,近期的作品将视觉语言模型(VLMs)整合到驱动管道中,使得视觉问题回答(VQA)[32,34]和语言指导推理[32,8].
尽管取得了成功,但现有的基于VLM的E2E方法通常通过扩大语言模型(LMs)来提高语言性能,从而引起大量的计算间接费用. DriveVLM [34],ORION [8],和AdaThinkDrive [25] 等方法使用了超过7B参数的模型,使得在边缘硬件上的实时部署越来越具有挑战性. 这促使我们研究如何用一个显著较小的LM实现强大的语言推理.

blocks.en: A second limitation is that these frameworks couple language reasoning tightly to the driving pipeline, requiring LM inference throughout deployment. To reduce this cost, some models run separate fast (standard E2E) and slow (VLM-based) branches and switch between them at runtime [ 30 , 10 , 41 ] , while others switch a single VLA between thinking and non-thinking modes [ 25 , 45 ] , but most of them still rely on a large model in complex scenes. Others distill the LM into the driving model, such as DiMA [ 11 ] , VLM-AD [ 38 ] , and VERDI [ 7 ] , but language only shapes the planner during training, and the planner cannot take reasoning as input at inference. DiMA’s Dual variant is the only one of them that is able to run the LM at inference, but it is evaluated only in open-loop settings, leaving the switching of the LM on and off in difficult closed-loop driving unexplored.
blocks.zh: 第二个限制是,这些框架将语言推理紧密地结合到驱动管道上,在整个部署过程中都需要LM推论。 为了降低这一成本,一些模型在运行时会分别运行快速(标准E2E)和慢(基于VLM)分支,并在运行时间[30,10,41]之间切换,而另一些模型则在思考模式和非思考模式[25,45]之间切换一个单一的VLA,但大多数在复杂的场景中仍然依赖于一个大模型. 其他人将LM蒸馏成驱动模型,如DIMA [11],VLM-AD [38],以及VERDI [7],但语言只在训练中塑造了规划者,规划者不能将推理作为推论的投入. DIMA的Dual变体是其中唯一能够通过推断运行LM的变体,但它只在开放-loop环境中被评价,使得LM的切换在困难的封闭-loop驱动中没有被探索.

blocks.en: We argue that efficiently integrating a language model into E2E driving requires two properties: compactness , so that the LM adds little computational cost, and detachability , so that the LM can be removed at runtime without degrading driving score. We propose DRIFT, an E2E driving framework that realizes this paradigm.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,高效地将语言模型融入E2E驱动需要两个属性:紧凑性,这样LM会增加很少的计算成本,以及可拆分性,这样可以在运行时删除LM而不降低驱动分数. 我们提议DRIFT,一个E2E驱动框架,实现这个范式.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Efficient driving VQA and action commentary with a compact LM: by aligning dense driving representations with the language embedding space, a 135M-parameter LM achieves competitive VQA and action commentary at an edge-compatible latency on a Jetson AGX Orin. Additionally, as an interesting finding, we show that language training also enriches the shared backbone features. • Detachable LM reasoning: we distill the LM’s reasoning into a lightweight surrogate module, so that a single planner can run on either reasoning source and the LM can be enabled or detached without degrading driving score. • Extensive closed-loop experiments on Bench2Drive show, first, that language training improves driving over the language-free base model (+0.5 DS), and second, that combining the LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate reaches 97.03 DS (+1.8 over TFv6/LEAD [ 27 ] ). On the real-world NAVSIM benchmark, DRIFT is competitive with much larger VLM-based planners, and on AlpaSim it is comparable to the LTFv6 and TransFuser-K1 baselines. Moreover, similar to Bench2Drive, enabling the LM on these benchmarks does not degrade planning performance, which shows that the detachable design carries over from simulation to real-world data.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 高效驱动 VQA 和行动评论与紧凑 LM:通过将密集的驱动表示与语言嵌入空间相配合,135M参数 LM 在Jetson AGX Orin上实现具有竞争力的 VQA 和行动评论在边缘兼容的空格上. 此外,作为一个有趣的发现,我们显示语言培训也丰富了共同的主干功能。 • 支助 可分离的LM推理:我们把LM的推理提炼成一个轻量级的代用模块,这样一个单一的策划者就可以运行在任一推理源上,而LM可以被启用或脱落而不降低驾驶分数. • 支助 在Bench2Drive上进行了广泛的闭路实验,首先,语言培训改进了无语言基模型(+0.5 DS)的驱动力,其次,将LM和替代推理结合到选定的推理率达到97.03 DS(比TFv6/LEAD[27]高+1.8). 在现实世界的NAVSIM基准上,DRIFT与更多基于VLM的规划者具有竞争力,在AlpaSim上,它与LTFv6和TransFuser-K1基线相当. 此外,与Benach2Drive类似,使这些基准上的LM能够不降低规划性能,这表明可分解的设计从模拟到现实世界的数据。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 VLMs in end-to-end autonomous driving
blocks.zh: 2.1 端到端自主驾驶中的VLM

blocks.en: Pioneering E2E autonomous driving models [ 16 , 14 , 46 ] show promising results in directly mapping raw sensors to actions. Recently, LEAD [ 27 ] showed that reducing the asymmetry between student and expert boosts performance, yielding the strong TFv6 and the diffusion-based BridgeDrive [ 23 ] models. However, despite their success, these models offer limited interpretability and lack explicit language reasoning. Hint-AD [ 5 ] improves interpretability by decoding language from the intermediate features of a frozen E2E model, but its language only explains the model’s decisions post hoc and does not influence driving. This motivates the integration of VLMs into E2E driving.
blocks.zh: 先锋E2E自主驱动模型[16,14,46]在直接将原始传感器映射到动作上显示出有希望的结果. 最近,LEAD [27] 显示降低学生和专家之间的不对称性能提升,产生了强大的TFv6和基于扩散的BridgeDrive[23]模型. 然而,这些模式尽管取得了成功,但可解释性有限,缺乏明确的语言推理。 Hint-AD [5]通过从冷冻的E2E模型的中间特征中解码语言来提高解释性,但其语言只解释了模型在事后的决定,并不影响驱动. 这促使VLMs融入E2E驱动.

blocks.en: VLM-based autonomous driving frameworks [ 24 , 26 , 44 , 40 , 37 , 18 , 36 , 43 ] show the potential of integrating LMs into E2E driving through VQA and language-guided driving. However, they were primarily evaluated in open-loop settings, which may not reflect real-world driving [ 21 , 15 ] . This has motivated closed-loop VLM-based driving [ 39 , 8 , 17 , 42 , 9 ] , where SimLingo [ 31 ] shows that a 1B model suffices when reasoning and driving actions are generated jointly, while LinkVLA [ 35 ] and FIVE-VLA [ 29 ] further improve efficiency. Yet these frameworks are computationally demanding because of their large LMs, the tight coupling between language reasoning and planning, or both, which limits deployment.
blocks.zh: 基于VLM的自主驾驶框架[24,26,44,40,37,18,36,43]显示LMs通过VQA和语言引导驾驶融入E2E驾驶的潜力. 然而,它们主要是在开放-开放环境中评估的,这可能不能反映现实世界的驱动[21,15]. 这推动了基于闭路VLM的驾驶[39,8,17,42,9],其中SimLingo[31]显示在联合产生推理和驾驶动作时1B模型就足够了,而LinkVLA[35]和FVE-VLA[29]则进一步提高了效率. 然而,这些框架在计算上要求很高,因为它们的LMs很大,语言推理和规划之间或两者紧密结合,限制了部署。

blocks.en: 2.2 Efficient reasoning for autonomous driving
blocks.zh: 2.2 自主驾驶的有效推理

blocks.en: To reduce the inference cost of VLMs, fast-slow methods invoke them only when needed. Dual-branch designs [ 34 , 30 , 10 , 41 , 20 ] pair a fast VLM-free path with a slow VLM path, while adaptive-thinking VLAs [ 25 , 45 , 22 ] switch a single model between thinking and direct action. However, most of them still rely on a large VLM or VLA, whose use remains mandatory in complex scenes, which limits deployment under resource constraints. DRIFT also invokes its LM at a chosen reasoning rate, but with a compact LM, a single planner, and the option to bypass the LM without a drop in driving performance.
blocks.zh: 为了降低VLM的推论成本,快速法只在需要时才引用. 双分支设计 [34, 30, 10, 41, 20] 将快速VLM无线路径与慢VLM路径对齐,而适应-思考VLA [25, 45, 22] 在思维和直接行动之间切换一个单一模式. 然而,其中大多数仍然依赖大型VLM或VLA,它们在复杂的场景中仍然必须使用,这限制了在资源限制下部署. DRIFT也以所选择的推理率引用其LM,但带有紧凑的LM,单机计划员,可以选择绕过LM而不降低驱动性能.

blocks.en: A complementary direction transfers VLM knowledge into the driving model during training so that the VLM can be dropped at deployment. VLM-AD [ 38 ] and VERDI [ 7 ] use an offline VLM to do reasoning on training samples and train the planner’s features to match text embeddings of it, whereas DiMA [ 11 ] jointly trains a large multi-modal LM (Vicuna 7B) with the planner and aligns their hidden features. In all three, language only shapes the planner during training and the planner cannot take reasoning as input at inference. DiMA’s Dual variant can also run the LM at inference by fusing LM and planner features, but these methods are evaluated mostly open-loop or in simplified closed-loop settings, so, to our knowledge, switching the LM on and off while driving was not evaluated. In DRIFT, a single planner works interchangeably and flexibly with both surrogate and LM reasoning sources in challenging closed-loop driving.
blocks.zh: 辅助方向在训练期间将VLM知识转移到驱动模型中,以便在部署时降低VLM. VLM-AD [38] 和 VERDI [7] 使用离线VLM在培训样本上进行推理,并训练规划师的特性,使其文本嵌入匹配,而DIMA [11] 则联合训练一个大型的多式LM(Vicuna 7B)与规划师并校正其隐藏的特性. 在所有三种情况下,语言只在训练期间塑造规划者,规划者不能将推理作为推论的投入. DIMA的双变体也可以通过Fusing LM和规划器的特性来进行LM的推导,但这些方法大多被评价为开闭式或简化闭闭闭式设置,所以据我们所知,在驾驶时切换LM的开关没有评价. 在DRIFT中,一个单一的策划者在挑战闭路驾驶时,与代理和LM推理源交互和灵活地工作.

blocks.en: 3 Proposed method: DRIFT
blocks.zh: 3个 拟议方法:DRIFT

blocks.en: In this section, we present DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework equipped with a lightweight, plug-and-play language reasoning module. An overview of the proposed architecture is shown in Fig. 1 . Given raw sensor observations, a TransFuser-based backbone extracts a dense scene representation, which serves as the input to the LM for VQA ( Sec. 3.1 ). In addition, the planner is conditioned on surrogate reasoning tokens that are aligned to the reasoning tokens of the LM, which can optionally replace them at inference ( Sec. 3.2 ), to facilitate aligned reasoning and driving decisions. Finally, Sec. 3.3 describes the training procedure that enables seamless integration of the detachable language module without degrading driving performance.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍DRIFT,一个E2E自主驱动框架,配备了轻量级,插座式和播放式语言推理模块. 图1概述了拟议的结构。 根据原始传感器观测,一个基于TransFuser的骨干提取出密集的场景代表,作为VQA(第3.1节)的LM输入. 此外,规划者还附带附加了与LM的推理符一致的代推理符,在推论中可以选择替换(第3.2节),以便于对齐推理和驱动决定. 最后,第3.3节介绍了能够无缝地整合可调试语言模块而不降低驾驶性能的培训程序。

blocks.en: 3.2 Detachable reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.2 可分离推理

blocks.en: Effective reasoning for autonomous driving requires alignment between language reasoning and driving decisions, as also highlighted in [ 31 ] . At the same time, we want the language module to be optional at runtime. We address both with a set of surrogate reasoning tokens that condition the planner together with dense scene features. They are predicted from BEV features alone, which makes the planner independent of the LM. The LM serves as the teacher during training, and as an optional replacement for the surrogate module at inference, allowing the planner to condition on language reasoning.
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶的有效推理需要语言推理和驾驶决定的一致,这也在[31]中得到了强调. 同时,我们希望语言模块在运行时是可选的. 我们用一套代用推理符号 来形容计划者 以及密集的场景特征 它们仅从BEV的特征来预测,这使得规划者独立于LM. LM在培训期间担任教师,并作为推论中代词模块的可选替代,使规划者能够以语言推理为条件.

blocks.en: Concretely, we use the generated commentary response as the reasoning signal, since it describes the current action together with its justification. During the final training stage and inference, the reasoning tokens are computed from the LM’s own greedy commentary, not from ground-truth text. We extract the last-layer hidden states at the generated answer positions, denoted as h c ​ q L h_{cq}^{L} , and pool them into K K fixed-size reasoning tokens Z r ​ e ​ a ​ s ​ o ​ n Z_{reason} through an attention pooling 𝒫 l → r \mathcal{P}_{l\rightarrow r} , in which K = 16 K{=}16 queries attend over the variable-length hidden states with padded positions masked. 𝒫 l → r \mathcal{P}_{l\rightarrow r} is randomly initialized and kept fixed, i.e., it receives no gradient, so Z r ​ e ​ a ​ s ​ o ​ n Z_{reason} is a fixed random-feature view of the LM hidden states, which are themselves trained by ℒ l ​ m \mathcal{L}_{lm} . In parallel, a lightweight surrogate projector 𝒫 v → r ~ \mathcal{P}_{v\rightarrow\tilde{r}} (a 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution followed by an attention pooling of the same form over the BEV grid) predicts K K surrogate reasoning tokens of the same shape from the BEV features F b ​ e ​ v L F_{bev}^{L} alone, Z ~ r ​ e ​ a ​ s ​ o ​ n = 𝒫 v → r ~ ​ ( F b ​ e ​ v L ) \tilde{Z}_{reason}=\mathcal{P}_{v\rightarrow\tilde{r}}(F_{bev}^{L}) . During training, the planner is conditioned on the last-layer BEV features together with the surrogate tokens, and the planning loss is applied only to this path. The LM tokens Z r ​ e ​ a ​ s ​ o ​ n Z_{reason} do not supervise the planner. Instead, they serve as detached targets (the alignment losses do not backpropagate into the LM or into 𝒫 l → r \mathcal{P}_{l\rightarrow r} ) that the surrogate tokens learn to mimic through a reasoning distillation ( Sec. 3.3 ), so that both token types live in the same representation space. We also tried feeding the LM tokens to the planner during training, i.e., additionally optimizing the planning loss on the LM path, but this degraded driving performance (see the supplementary), so the planner is trained on the surrogate tokens only.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Training schedule
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 培训时间表

blocks.en: Motivated by the number of modules and their dependencies, we split training into three stages. Stage 1 trains the backbone and perception heads to produce the visual features all downstream modules rely on. Stage 2 trains the language modules (the LM with LoRA, the projector, and the surrogate projector) to answer VQAs and reason in language, as well as the auxiliary perception tasks of Stage 1, with the alignment losses active on the ground-truth commentary (teacher-forced), while the backbone receives the LM gradient scaled down by 0.1. Stage 3 is the final end-to-end training. Stage 3a trains the backbone, planner, and surrogate path on all frames without the LM. Stage 3b additionally trains the LM jointly: the alignment losses are re-introduced with reduced weights and a warm-up, and are computed on the LM’s own greedy commentary, which matches inference and avoids targets that depend on the expert’s future, at the cost of one extra LM pass per step (the language loss uses the teacher-forced pass). Ground-truth text is used earlier because it is cheap and informative while the LM is still weak.
blocks.zh: 由于单元的数量及其依赖性,我们把培训分为三个阶段。 第一阶段培训骨干和感官头,以制作所有下游模块所依赖的视觉特征。 第2阶段训练语言模块(LM与LORA,投影仪,以及代理投影仪)在语言中解答VQA和理由,以及第1阶段的辅助感知任务,在地面-真实性评语(教师强制)上激活对齐损失,而骨干则得到LM梯度缩放0.1. 第三阶段是最终的端对端训练. 阶段 3a 在所有帧上训练骨干,计划员,以及代步路径,而不使用 LM. 第3b阶段还联合训练LM:调整损失在减重和加热的情况下被重新引入,并且根据LM自己的贪婪评论进行计算,这符合推论,避免了取决于专家未来的目标,每步增加一次LM传球(语言损失使用教师强制传球)的代价. 更早使用地面真言文字,因为它在LM还很弱的同时廉价且信息丰富.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluate DRIFT in closed loop on the challenging Bench2Drive benchmark [ 15 ] in the CARLA simulator [ 6 ] , reporting Driving Score (DS) and Success Rate (SR). We focus on closed-loop evaluation, since the planner’s actions affect subsequent states, which reflects driving behavior better than open-loop evaluation [ 31 , 46 ] . Training uses the LEAD dataset [ 27 ] , for which we generate VQA annotations following DriveLM [ 32 ] and commentary annotations following SimLingo [ 31 ] ; language quality is measured with SPICE, CIDEr, BLEU-4, ROUGE-L and METEOR. To evaluate DRIFT on real-world data, we train it on the navtrain split of NAVSIM [ 4 , 2 ] and report the PDM Score (PDMS) on navtest and the extended PDM Score (EPDMS) on navhard. We additionally evaluate it in closed loop on the nuPlan track of AlpaSim [ 28 ] , following the 123D protocol [ 3 ] . Language annotations for NAVSIM are generated with Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] . Training consists of three stages, namely perception pre-training following TFv6 [ 27 ] , LoRA [ 12 ] finetuning of the LM with the alignment losses, and end-to-end training, and runs on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. Further details on the data, metrics and training are in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 我们根据CARLA模拟器中具有挑战性的Bench2Drive基准[15],对DRIFT进行闭环评估,报告驾驶分数和成功率。 我们专注于闭路评估,因为规划者的行动会影响后来的状态,这反映出驱动行为比闭路评估更好[31,46]. 训练使用LEAD数据集[27],我们为此在DriveLM[32]之后生成VQA说明,在SimLingo[31]之后生成评注说明;语言质量用SPICE,CIDER,BLEU-4,ROUGE-L和METEOR来衡量. 为了在现实世界数据上评价DRIFT,我们用NAVSIM[4,2]的导航分数对其进行培训,并报告PDM Score(PDMS)的导航测试和扩展PDM Score(EPDMS)的导航分数. 我们还在AlpaSim的NuPlan轨道上,按照123D协议[3]进行闭环评估。 NAVSIM的语言说明用Quen3-VL[1]生成. 培训包括三个阶段,即继TFv6[27]之后的感官预训,LORA[12]根据校正损失对LM进行微调,以及端到端培训,并运行在8台NVIDIA H100 GPU上. 关于数据、衡量标准和培训的进一步详情见补充部分。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: We compare DRIFT with prior language-based models in Tab. 1 . Benefiting from the finding of LEAD [ 27 ] that reducing the learner–expert asymmetry improves imitation learning, DRIFT is trained on the data collected by LEAD. Some works use additionally collected data, which results in inconsistent training data across methods, from the 234K frames of the Bench2Drive training set to 3.1M frames for SimLingo, and some do not report it (see the column in the table). Hence, the numbers are not strictly comparable, and we read them as a comparison of complete driving recipes, i.e., data, backbone, and architecture together. In this comparison, DRIFT w/ LM improves over the strongest language-based model, LinkVLA [ 35 ] , by 6.0 DS and 14.8 SR with about 4 × 4\times fewer parameters (255M vs. 1B). Moreover, SimLingo [ 31 ] reports that its language-free version, SimLingo-BASE, drives as well as the full model, i.e., language preserves but does not improve its driving performance, whereas in DRIFT the LM can improve it within a single model.
blocks.zh: 我们比较DRIFT和Tab中以前的基于语言的模型. 1. 减少学习者 -- -- 专家不对称 -- -- 有助于模仿学习的 " LEAD[27] " 发现,DRIFT接受了关于 " LEAD " 收集的数据的培训。 一些作品使用额外收集的数据,导致不同方法的培训数据不一致,从Bench2Drive培训集的234K帧到SimLingo的3.1M帧,有些作品不报告(见表中的栏目). 因此,这些数字没有严格的可比性,我们把这些数字看作是对完整的驱动方法,即数据、骨干和结构的比较。 在这个比较中,DRIFT w/LM比最强的基于语言的模型LinkVLA[35]改进了6.0 DS和14.8 SR,参数约4×4\时(255M vs 1B). 此外,SimLingo [31] 报告说,它的无语言版本SimLingo-BASE,驱动以及全模型,即语言保存但并不改进其驱动性能,而在DRIFT中,LM可以在单一模型内改进.

blocks.en: Next, we compare DRIFT with and without language invocation to the non-language models TFv6 [ 27 ] and BridgeDrive [ 23 ] , which are trained on the same LEAD data. Without the LM, DRIFT is on par with TFv6 (DS 95.97 vs. 95.2). Invoking the LM then adds 1.1 DS, giving the best result on Bench2Drive: DRIFT w/ LM reaches 97.03 DS and 89.39 SR, ahead of TFv6 by 1.8 DS and 2.6 SR. BridgeDrive is a diffusion-based model with a more complex planning head. Against it, the margin is smaller (+0.7 DS) and mostly within one standard deviation of the evaluation runs, making DRIFT slightly ahead in DS.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将DRIFT与非语言模型TFv6[27]和BridgeDrive[23]进行比对,并且没有语言引用,这些模型都接受了同样的LEAD数据的培训. 没有LM,DRIFT与TFv6(DS 95.97 vs 95.2)处于同等地位. 引用LM之后增加了1.1个DS,给出了Bench2Drive的最佳结果:DRIFT w/LM达到97.03个DS和89.39个SR,比TFv6领先1.8个DS和2.6个SR. 桥 Drive是一种基于传播的模型,具有更复杂的规划头. 与之相反,比值较小(+0.7 DS),且大多在评价运行的一个标准差内,使得DRIFT在DS中略为领先.

blocks.en: Besides competitive driving performance, DRIFT also produces high-quality language ( Tab. 2 ). On DriveLM-CARLA, DRIFT with a 135M-parameter LM achieves performance comparable to SimLingo (0.5B). Both are evaluated zero-shot there after being trained on separate datasets. We attribute this efficiency to our feature-selection and projector designs. DRIFT decodes language directly from the driving backbone’s intermediate representations. Because these features already encode rich, planning-oriented information on the driving scenario, a small model is sufficient for language decoding in the form of structured driving VQA and commentary.
blocks.zh: 除了有竞争力的驾驶性能,DRIFT还产生高质量的语言(Tab. 2). 在DriveLM-CARLA上,具有135M参数LM的DRIFT实现性能与SimLingo(0.5B)相当. 在对两者进行单独数据集培训后,都在那里进行了零射值评价。 我们把这种效率归因于我们的特色选择和投影设计。 DRIFT直接从驱动主干线的中间表示解码语言. 因为这些特征已经编码了丰富的,面向规划的驾驶情景信息,一个小模型就足以以结构化驾驶VQA和评论的形式进行语言解码.

blocks.en: Crucially, the language head and the planner consume the same backbone features, so the LM’s outputs are grounded in the representation used for driving, which makes the generated language suitable as a reasoning signal for the planner. The commentary response, which states the intended action together with its justification, is reliable enough to serve both as the target that the surrogate reasoning tokens distill from during training, and as the planner’s conditioning when the LM is invoked at inference. The commentary answers are more demanding than DriveLM answers, since they must state the intended action together with its justification instead of only describing the scene. As shown in Tab. 2 , they still reach high quality (SPICE 82.20), confirming their suitability as the reasoning signal.
blocks.zh: 关键是,语言头和规划师消耗相同的主干功能,因此LM的输出基于用于驾驶的表示,这使得生成的语言适合作为规划师的推理信号. 评论答复指出打算采取的行动及其理由,它足够可靠,既可作为替代推理标志从培训中提炼出来的目标,又可作为规划者在推断援引LM时的前提。 评注的答复比DriveLM的答复要求更高,因为它们必须说明打算采取的行动及其理由,而不只是说明场景。 如塔布所示. 2,它们仍然达到高品质(SPICE 82.20),确认它们是否适合作为推理信号.

blocks.en: 4.3 Insights
blocks.zh: 4.3 见解

blocks.en: Because the LM in DRIFT is detachable, we can study how often reasoning needs to be invoked. We vary the reasoning rate (RR), i.e., the LM is invoked every RR frames and the surrogate reasoning is used in between ( Fig. 3 ), and make two observations. First, invoking the LM periodically slightly improves driving over the model without LM (95.97 DS), with the best setting, RR=2, reaching 97.03 DS (+1.06 over no LM, 95% route-level bootstrap CI [0.2, 2.0]). Since we selected RR on this benchmark, we regard the gain as indicative. The gains of the other rates are within run-to-run variation. Second, invoking the LM at every frame (RR=1) is on par with no reasoning (96.06 vs. 95.97 DS) and below the intermediate rates. We use a fixed reasoning rate, which gives predictable latency at runtime. Because surrogate and LM tokens are interchangeable, the switch between them could also be controlled by an adaptive trigger; since a trigger brings its own design choices and failure modes that could confound the impact of DRIFT, we leave studying adaptive strategies to future work.
blocks.zh: 由于DRIFT中的LM是可分解的,我们可以研究推理需要引用的频率. 我们改变推理率(RR),即每个RR框架引用LM,在(图3)之间使用替代推理,并给出两个观察. 首先,不定期引用LM(95.97 DS),在没有LM(95.97 DS)的情况下,驾驶在车型上略有改进,最好的设置是RR=2,达到97.03 DS(在无LM(+1.06),95%的路由级护靴CI[0.2,2.0]). 由于我们在这一基准上选择了经常资源,我们认为这一收益是指示性的。 其他费率的收益在运行中的变化幅度内。 第二,在每个框架(RR=1)引用LM与没有推理(96.06对95.97DS)并低于中间费率。 我们使用一个固定的推理率,在运行时给予可预测的耐久性. 由于代用和LM符号是可互换的,所以它们之间的开关也可以由适应性触发器控制;由于一个触发器会带来自己的设计选择和失败模式,从而混淆DRIFT的影响,所以我们把研究适应性策略留给未来工作.

blocks.en: To understand why the LM and surrogate paths differ, we visualize the Grad-CAM heatmaps of the reasoning tokens produced by the LM and surrogate paths for an unprotected junction left turn scenario ( Fig. 2 ). The surrogate branch mainly focuses on the ego lane and a few localized cues, such as the traffic light. In contrast, the language reasoning branch shows broader contextual awareness, attending not only to the ego lane but also to semantically relevant cues such as the oncoming vehicle and the pedestrian crossings.
blocks.zh: 为了理解LM和代位路径为何不同,我们将LM制作的推理符的Grad-CAM热映射和未受保护的左转情景的代位路径(图2)想象出来. 代号分支主要关注自负道和交通灯等少数局部提示. 与此相反,语言推理处显示出了更广泛的背景意识,不仅关注自我道,而且还关注诸如即将到来的车辆和行人过道等切身相关的提示。

blocks.en: These observations suggest that the two reasoning paths provide complementary information. The LM contributes richer scene-level reasoning for complex decisions, while the surrogate emphasizes localized cues that suffice for most planning updates. Consistently, the gain of RR=2 concentrates in negotiation scenarios, e.g., unprotected left turns (DS 84.5 without LM vs. 96.9 at RR=2 on 15 routes). Refreshing language reasoning at a moderate rate thus lets DRIFT benefit from semantic reasoning without overriding the stable surrogate reasoning at every step. More analysis is in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 这些意见表明,这两个推理途径提供了补充信息。 LM为复杂决定提供了更丰富的场景级推理,而代词则强调局部提示,足以满足大多数规划更新. 一贯地,RR=2的收益集中在谈判情况下,例如,无保护的左转(DS 84.5没有LM对96.9,RR=2在15条路线上)。 因此,以适度的速度更新语言推理使DRIFT从语义推理中受益,而不会凌驾于每个步骤的稳定代词推理之上。 补充分析内容更多。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Grad-CAM maps for the LM and surrogate paths in a junction left turn scenario. While the LM maintains broader attention across all critical scene objects, the surrogate path focuses more narrowly on driving-relevant segments.
blocks.zh: 图2 : LM 的 Grad-CAM 地图和交汇左转情景中的替代路径. 虽然LM对所有关键场景对象保持更广泛的关注,但替代路径更狭隘地侧重于驱动相关部分.

blocks.en: We measure how well the LM’s textual reasoning agrees with the action taken by the planner in DRIFT, with the LM invoked at every frame (RR=1). As a baseline we use a decoupled variant of DRIFT, in which the LM is trained on the same commentary data but the planner is never conditioned on its reasoning. Since DRIFT predicts path and speed separately, we evaluate the lateral and longitudinal axes separately, both in closed loop on Bench2Drive and in open loop on NAVSIM ( Tab. 3 ). The evaluation protocol and the decoupled models are described in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量LM的文字推理是否与DRIFT的规划者采取的行动一致,每个框架都引用LM(RR=1). 作为基线,我们使用DRIFT的脱钩变体,在这种变体中,LM接受相同评注数据的培训,但规划者从不以推理为条件。 由于 DRIFT 分别预测路径和速度,我们分别评价横向轴和纵向轴,无论是在Bench2Drive的闭环还是NAVSIM(Tab. 3 )的开环中. 评估协议和脱钩模型在补充中描述.

blocks.en: Both variants are far above the constant-answer reference. The decoupled variant is already well aligned, which is expected since the commentary and the planner’s ground truth come from the same expert. Furthermore, linking the planner to the LM’s reasoning increases longitudinal agreement by 6.0 points on Bench2Drive (93.2 vs. 87.2) and 3.4 points on NAVSIM (79.4 vs. 76.0), where planning is highly multi-modal [ 46 ] . Laterally, both variants agree equally (85.2 vs. 85.0 and 89.4 vs. 88.9), as lateral decisions are largely determined by the road geometry [ 46 ] . While both benchmarks show similar trends, the numbers should not be compared directly, as their evaluation protocols differ. Lateral agreement is a coarse measure, since several descriptions can be correct for the same situation, so 85% reflects a limit of the evaluation rather than low alignment.
blocks.zh: 两个变体都远远高于常答参考. 脱钩的变体已经非常吻合,这是预期的,因为评注和规划者的基本真相来自同一专家。 此外,将规划员与LM的推理联系起来,使Bench2Drive(93.2对87.2)和NAVSIM(79.4对76.0)的纵向协议增加了6.0点,其中规划高度多模式[46]。 平时,两种变体均同意(85.2 vs 85.0 and 89.4 vs 88.9),因为平时决定主要由道路几何[46]决定. 虽然这两个基准都显示出类似的趋势,但不应直接比较这些数字,因为它们的评价协议不同。 横向协议是一种粗糙的措施,因为几种描述可以对同样的情况正确,因此85%反映了评价的限度而不是低调.

blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 内置推论效率

blocks.en: We evaluate embedded inference on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin in MAXN power mode at batch size one ( Tab. 4 ). The backbone and planner use static-shape TensorRT engines, and the language model runs in TensorRT Edge-LLM. LoRA weights are merged in FP32 before FP16 export. Numerically sensitive backbone attention, normalization, and reductions remain in FP32.

blocks.en:
We adapt Edge-LLM to accept projected multimodal embeddings and return final-layer hidden states for generated answer tokens. Attention pooling reduces these states to fixed-size reasoning tokens for the planner, keeping intermediate features on the GPU. KV caching avoids repeated prompt computation, while reusing answer states avoids full-sequence replay when token alignment permits. Language reasoning runs at every planning step when enabled.
SimLingo uses the same TensorRT and Edge-LLM approach, with BF16 driving heads.
Latency is averaged over closed-loop inference calls with varying scenes and generated answer lengths. Peak NvMap GPU allocation and logical FLOPs (FMA = 2 {}=2 ) use separate fixed-input profiles. Sampled peak GPU allocation is 0.48 GiB with the LM unloaded and 1.69 GiB with it resident for runtime switching.

blocks.en: 4.5 Real-world applicability
blocks.zh: 4.5 现实世界的适用性

blocks.en: To show that DRIFT is directly applicable to real-world scenarios, we evaluate it on NAVSIM and AlpaSim. On NAVSIM ( Tab. 5 ), we first compare against recent VLM-based planners that do not directly optimize the task score, following [ 27 ] . DRIFT without the LM reaches 87.4 PDMS with only 125M parameters. Among the reported VLM-based planners, which are 16–64 × \times larger (2B–8B), it outperforms three and ties with SGDrive (87.4 PDMS). Compared with the recently proposed Qwen-Drive-1.0 [ 43 ] , a 4B VLM planner trained on 24 public VQA datasets, which we re-evaluated ourselves, DRIFT comes within 0.5 PDMS on navtest (87.4 vs. 87.9) at 1 / 32 1/32 of its size, and is ahead on the harder navhard split (32.5 vs. 30.5 EPDMS). Next, we compare against the direct baseline LTFv6 [ 27 ] with the same RegNetY-032 backbone, where DRIFT is on par in PDMS ( + 0.4 +0.4 ) and ahead in EPDMS ( + 2.3 +2.3 ). Enabling the language model does not degrade performance (87.3 PDMS and 32.8 EPDMS, within noise of the planner alone) while adding explainability. Evaluation details and full results are provided in the supplementary. On the closed-loop AlpaSim, DRIFT scores 89.5 with and without the LM, so detachability carries over to real-world scenes. It is comparable to the LTFv6 baseline (88.6, within the ± \pm 1.4 scene-level interval) and below Qwen-Drive (91.7, SFT), which sees more cameras and frames, whereas DRIFT only receives a coarse command. It is also comparable to the very recent TransFuser-K1 [ 3 ] (89.6 without navigation), which is trained on significantly more data.

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 4.6 读取研究

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Feature selection and projectors
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 特征选择和投影仪

blocks.en: We first study which backbone features the LM should read ( Tab. 6 , top). On the LEAD validation split, all variants exhibit strong performances, showing that the intermediate driving features already enable strong language decoding : even LiDAR-only features reach 94.88 SPICE. The largest gain comes from replacing LiDAR with RGB features (METEOR 63.47 → \rightarrow 64.38), as RGB carries fine-grained cues (colors, lane types, traffic lights and signs) that are not possible or hard to decode from LiDAR. Combining LiDAR with RGB gives only a negligible improvement, yet we retain LiDAR features since the planner requires it, and sharing the features between the LM and the planner keeps the language grounded in what the planner observes. The ego-speed and target-point projectors give a small gain, concentrated in the speed projector. We keep the target point since it conveys the route intent on which action commentary depends (e.g., which way to turn), although this is not visible in the metrics averaged over all question types.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究哪一条主干线的LM应该读(表6,顶部)。 在LEAD验证拆分上,所有变体都表现出强烈的性能,表明中间驱动特性已经能够实现强语言解码 :甚至连LiDAR唯一的特性都达到了94.88 SPICE. 最大的收益来自于用RGB的特性(METEOR 63.47 ~\rightarrow 64.38)取代LiDAR,因为RGB带有无法或难以从LiDAR解码的精细刻度的提示(颜色,车道类型,交通灯和标志). 将LiDAR与RGB结合只能带来微乎其微的改进,然而我们保留了LiDAR的特征,因为规划者需要它,在LM和规划者之间共享的特征使语言建立在规划者所观察到的东西上. 自我速度和瞄准点投影仪能带来小收益,集中在速度投影仪上. 我们保留目标点,因为它传达了行动评论所依赖的路线意图(例如,如何转弯),尽管这一点在所有问题类型的平均值中并不明显。

blocks.en: We next study how the driving features should be projected into the language input space ( Tab. 6 , bottom) and compare a two-layer MLP, which keeps all visual tokens, with three attention-based projectors that compress them into learned queries: cross-attention (128 queries), deformable attention (64 queries), and a spatial variant with a 2D locality bias (128 queries). The simple MLP outperforms all attention-based projectors on all metrics , with the deformable variant much worse (METEOR 53.45) and the spatial variant on par with plain cross-attention (62.18 vs. 62.45). Hence, the selected features need no additional attention stage or compression before entering the LM, and the gap between the backbone’s feature space and the LM’s embedding space is small enough for a lightweight per-token mapping to bridge.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来研究如何将驱动特性投射到语言输入空间(Tab. 6,底部),并比较一个两层的MLP,它保留所有视觉符号,有三个基于注意力的投影器将其压缩成学到的询问:交叉注意(128个查询),变形注意(64个查询),一个空间变体,2D位偏差(128个查询). 简单的MLP在所有度量标准上都超过了所有基于注意力的投影仪,可变形变体更差(MEDEOR 53.45),空间变体与平坦跨心等效(62.18 vs 62.45)。 因此,在进入LM之前,选定的特性不需要额外的注意阶段或压缩,骨干特征空间与LM嵌入空间之间的间隔也足够小,可以进行轻量级的按键绘图以桥接.

blocks.en: 4.6.2 Training stages
blocks.zh: 4.6.2 培训阶段

blocks.en: We analyze the impact of each training stage in Tab. 7 . All variants start from the same perception backbone, pre-trained for 30 epochs in Stage 1. DRIFT-Base is the driving-only model without any language, trained for 31 epochs E2E. Adding 2 epochs of VQA pre-training before the same E2E training improves DS from 95.45 to 95.94 (+0.49). This gain is modest given the run-to-run variance, but it appears where expected: in scenarios with vulnerable road users, DS rises from 94.13 to 97.75 and pedestrian collisions drop from 7 to 2. Although the BEV semantic decoders of DRIFT-Base mostly work reliably, Figure 4 shows an example of such failures, with more in the supplementary: DRIFT-Base barely detects a crossing pedestrian, whereas after VQA pre-training the pedestrian is clearly grounded. The LM of this variant, however, has been finetuned on driving VQA for only 2 epochs and still answers “accelerate”. Since this LM is not trained during E2E driving, we do not evaluate its LM path. Our final model therefore adds 16 epochs of joint commentary training, in which the surrogate reasoning is trained to match the LM’s. This sharpens the reasoning (“remain stopped due to the pedestrian”) and raises the commentary SPICE from 76.90 to 82.20, at no cost for the surrogate path (95.97 vs. 95.94). The resulting LM path drives equally well when invoked at every frame (96.06 DS) and reaches 97.03 DS at RR=2.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we argue that VLM-based E2E driving models become more practical by following two design choices: compactness and detachability. To this end, we introduce DRIFT, which shows that rich intermediate driving features enable effective visual question answering and action commentary with a compact LM of under 150M parameters, connected through a simple per-token projector. A surrogate reasoning module trained via knowledge distillation allows the LM to be detached at inference without sacrificing driving performance. On Bench2Drive, DRIFT with LM reasoning reaches up to 97.03 DS and 89.39% SR with about 4 × 4\times fewer parameters than the strongest language-based model. Our analysis shows that VQA training can help encode additional features in the driving backbone. It further shows that linking the planner to the LM’s reasoning at inference improves the alignment between the generated language and the planned speed, compared to a decoupled variant. Moreover, benchmarking DRIFT on NAVSIM and AlpaSim shows competitive driving quality with a drastically smaller footprint.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们争辩说,基于VLM的E2E驱动模型通过遵循两个设计选择变得更加实用:紧凑性和可分离性. 为此,我们引入了DRIFT,它显示丰富的中间驱动特性使得有效的视觉问题解答和动作评语能够使用150M参数以下的紧凑LM,通过简单的每台投影仪连接. 通过知识蒸馏培训的代用推理模块可以使LM在不牺牲驾驶性能的情况下在推论上脱落. 在Bench2Drive上,具有LM推理的DRIFT达到了97.03DS和89.39%的SR,其参数比最强的语言模型少了约4×4\的时间. 我们的分析表明,VQA训练可以帮助编码驱动骨干中的其他功能. 它进一步表明,将规划者与LM推论联系起来,可以改善生成语言与计划速度之间的校正,而比起一个脱钩变体. 此外,以NAVSIM和AlpaSim为基准的DRIFT显示出具有竞争力的驾驶质量,足迹小得多。
